_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: count the same steps along a row, or three letters in a row; 2: steps that wrap past Z or go back, a letter's opposite, or rows that add up to the same total; 3: letters changed to their places and one sum or product worked out; 4: places counted from Z, the letter in the middle, squares, or column totals that are multiples of the top. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
